text:
jamie_csm: FYI — QBR for HelioWorks next Thu 9am PT. Primary ask: show cost-reduction plan + onboarding status. Need a crisp "savings delta" slide. Who owns modeling? 

nora_cs: I'll take modeling. I'll produce status quo vs optimized spend + a simple graph. 

liam_se: Heads up — they rolled an embed-heavy batch last weekend; peak embedding calls spiked x3 and wiped their credit buffer. Need to show top callers and suggest a throttle ladder. 

alerts_bot: infra-alert: account=helioworks daily_tokens=2.4M (2026-04-02T05:12:00Z) — budget_alert triggered. 

olivia_fin: Renewal currently tbd. Finance wants committed runway or a clear mitigation path. I can draft commit options and soft-commit trial. 

nora_cs: Quick forecast notes: Baseline monthly = ~7.8M tokens. With targeted prefix caching + job-windowed batching we estimate token usage -30% (conservative). If they take small Dedicated for embeddings, cost/unit drops another ~15%. 

liam_se: Sample route query I used:```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) tokens, count(*) calls
FROM usage
WHERE account='helioworks' AND time >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 8;
``` 

nora_cs: Proposed QBR playbook: 1) Immediate: enable prefix caching for history routes + set soft throttle at 1.2M/day; 2) 7-day: enable batching (150ms) for bulk embeds; 3) 21-day: test quantized reranker on staging; 4) Offer 3mo soft-commit pilot to cap unit costs. 

liam_se: Throttle ladder snippet to include in deck:```yaml
throttle_policies:
  - name: embed_soft
    threshold_daily_tokens: 1200000
    action: soft_throttle
    ramp: 10%/hour
  - name: embed_hard
    threshold_daily_tokens: 2000000
    action: hard_throttle
``` 

olivia_fin: Can you also add a sensitivity table with credit runway? I want to show "credits left" vs "days to exhaustion" under both scenarios. 

nora_cs: Will do. I'll add two columns: status_quo and optimized. Also include estimated partnership discount if they sign 6mo commit. 

liam_se: I'll generate top-8 routes + estimated % savings per route after caching/batching and attach before EOD. 

alerts_bot: note: #cs-escalations tagged for the QBR prep thread. Dry-run scheduled Tue 8am PT. 

jamie_csm: Action items recap: (1) @nora_cs deliver forecast & slides; (2) @liam_se attach route-savings table; (3) @olivia_fin draft commit tiers + runway calc; (4) @jamie_csm request customer usage quote and product impact line. 

olivia_fin: I'll attempt to get a usage blurb from their PM; if not, I'll use anonymized metric. 

nora_cs: I'll post a Google Slides link and a quick cost-sensitivity CSV. 

jamie_csm: Great. Let's aim to convert this risk into a renewal with a clear, measurable plan. :rocket:

(ends)
